title: Emergent Misalignment Can Be Induced by Sycophancy and Reversed via Alignment Gating
reasoning: The paper explores 'Emergent Misalignment' in LLMs, specifically focusing on unethical and harmful behaviors. It benchmarks model performance against human values and safety standards, including evaluations of social biases (gender roles) and discrimination against religious groups (specifically Buddhists) to measure misalignment with ethical and moral norms.
